outline:
介紹最新製造技術中的特殊項目，包括：
1、製造實驗及統計分析
2、製造設備，強調電腦化的運動控制及製程控制
3、電腦化的製造系統，如CAD、CAM、CIM、LAN及因電腦化產生的系統進化。
Introducing special topics of newest manufacturing technology. Including:
1.Manufacturing experiments and statistical evaluation.
2.Manufacturing equipment, emphasizing on computerized motion control and process control.
3.Computerized manufacturing system, like CAD, CAM, CIM, LAN, and manufacturing system 's evolution due to computerization.
schedule:
weeks 01-02 Introduction and hardware/software preparation
weeks 03-05 Micro-level simulation with validation based on CAD/CAM/CIM
weeks 06-08 Micro-level simulation with verification based on PLC
week09 midterm week (no lecture)~midterm project delivery
weeks 10-12 Macro-level simulation with a virtual factory platform
weeks 13-14 Simulation for profit making
weeks 15-17 Metrology as modern manufacturing technology
week18 final week (no lecture)~final project delivery
